headline: China Vanke and Wanda Tycoons Shift Focus to Urban Renewal Projects
summary: China Vanke founder Wang Shi and Dalian Wanda chairman Wang Jianlin have launched new corporate initiatives dedicated to commercial building renovations and urban renewal amidst the ongoing property downturn.
why: Chinese property developers face persistent sales contractions, driving former real estate titans to pivot toward asset-light operations and refurbishment of existing assets.

impacts.name: China Real Estate
impacts.why: Pivots by major real estate founders indicate shifting capital toward urban renewal amid depressed primary home sales.
